content: Next.js 15 (latest 15.5.28 as of Oct 2026, stable since Oct 2024) ships with App Router as the default paradigm. Every component defaults to Server Component; add 'use client' only for event handlers, browser APIs (window/localStorage), or React state/effects. Data fetching happens inside the component that needs it — no prop-drilling from getServerSideProps. Caching changed in v15: fetch requests, GET route handlers, and client navigations are NOT cached by default anymore. Server Actions replace API routes for mutations. Turbopack is stable for dev. PPR (Partial Prerendering) is stable.
